items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: Then sometimes I would work in a small group with Doc, and another friend of mine, a saxophone player named Ricky Roseman(?).

ctx.x: Yeah, we played dance ballrooms, you know -- mostly. Then sometimes I would work in a small group with Doc, and another friend of mine, a saxophone player named Ricky Roseman(?). Ricky also played with Doc's band at different times. And we worked at what they called then Pig-Stands, which later became drive-ins. You know, they used to sell pig...pork sandwiches on a bun.
